title: ECDSA op_fd leaked in sign and verify paths
description:
crypto2dev_ecdsa() acquires an op_fd via pool_acquire() for DO_SIGN and DO_VERIFY ioctls, then calls pool_release() without first calling close(op_fd).

pool_release() opens a NEW fd for the pool slot but does NOT close the caller's acquired fd (by design — caller owns it). Compare: cipher path at line 833-836 does close(op_fd) THEN pool_release().

Trigger: any ECDSA sign or verify operation.
Outcome: 1 fd leaked per operation. Under TLS load (ECDSA handshakes), process fd table exhausts → EMFILE → WC_HW_E on all subsequent crypto ops → denial of service.

Fix: add close(op_fd) before each pool_release() in the sign (line ~1360) and verify (line ~1425) paths, matching the cipher path pattern.
